messages.subject: Neckwarmer
messages.text:
Hi

 
I have been enjoying my mittens during the winter season. They have been holding up well. I just received my order for the headband and neckwarmer. The headband fits very well and I expect to really enjoy it when biking on cool days. 

 

 
I'm not sure I've figured out the neckwarmer though. From the pictures on the website, it looks like it pulls down over the head. However, there is not enough stretch to make this easy. If I pull very hard I can get it on, but it is very difficult to get
 off by pulling up. Can I expect it to stretch a bit over time? It's kind of hard on the ears doing this! Or did I miss an opening with velcro that assists with getting it on? 

 

 
Thanks

 

 
Shelley Malyk

 
Winnipeg, MB

 

 

 

 
 
 
 

 Climate change is a serious, urgent issue affecting every one of us. Find out about an abundance of inspiring solutions,
 including how can make your own, individual difference, at www.regeneration.org (http://www.regeneration.org/) . 

 Recently, we took advantage of federal and provincial grants to install a heat pump for reducing our carbon footprint. 
 Start here: Canada
 Greener Homes Grant (https://natural-resources.canada.ca/energy-efficiency/homes/canada-greener-homes-initiative/canada-greener-homes-grant/canada-greener-homes-grant/23441)
